Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Manage your risk rules, trading tags, and app preferences.
Settings.profile_desc: Update your display name, avatar, and trading preferences.
Settings.timezone_desc: This timezone is used to sync your Daily Loss reset and trading history.
Settings.security_desc: Update your email address or change your password.
Settings.risk_desc: Configure warning thresholds and enforcement. Applies to active account:
Settings.daily_loss_desc: Notify me when I reach this percentage of my Daily Loss limit.
Settings.drawdown_desc: Notify me when I reach this percentage of my Trailing/Max Drawdown limit.
Settings.tilt_guard_desc: When enabled, you will be blocked from logging new trades if you breach your Max Daily Loss limit for the day.
Settings.select_account: Please select an active account from the Accounts page first.
Settings.tags_desc: Customize the tags you use when logging trades for better psychological review.
Settings.app_desc: Customize the look and feel of your app.
Settings.privacy_mode_desc: Hide sensitive monetary values on the dashboard
